name: csas-engine
description: CSAS Engine – Context-Adaptive Semantic Application Screening

scripts.dev: concurrently -n django,vite -c blue,green "backend/venv/bin/python backend/manage.py runserver" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.setup: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd frontend && npm install && cd .. && npm install && cd backend && python manage.py migrate && python seed_jobs.py
